items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Have you ever heard that name before? [INTERVIEWEE] No I haven't.

ctx.x: Well anyway, there's a lot of them, a tremendous number of people that you, you know had contact with. One way or the other in those days.

Oh yeah. But there used to be a good fiddle player around then by the name of Bobby Hargraves. Used to be another banjo player around then. Later on he switched over to guitar. Seminole. Have you ever heard that name before?
